title: CURIE Registry for DID/NDI V_gamma
description: Registry mapping CURIE prefixes (used in ontology_term.node values and in field-level ontology.node annotations) to their authoritative URI base and metadata. Consumer tooling uses this file to expand a CURIE such as 'UBERON:0002436' into the full URI 'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_0002436'. Prefixes are matched case-insensitively and written as each entry's `spelling`, the form the identifier's issuer cites.

iao.label: Information Artifact Ontology
iao.documentation: OBO Foundry ontology for information entities. Expansion rule: 'IAO:NNNNNNN' -> 'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_NNNNNNN'.
iao.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

uberon.label: Uber-anatomy Ontology
uberon.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

pato.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

emapa.label: Mouse Developmental Anatomy Ontology (abstract)
emapa.documentation: Anatomical ontology for the developing mouse.
emapa.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

ncit.label: NCI Thesaurus
ncit.documentation: Controlled vocabulary for biomedical concepts. An OBO-style mirror is available at the given base; the canonical browser lives at https://ncit.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/.
ncit.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

stato.label: Statistical Methods Ontology
stato.documentation: OBO Foundry ontology of statistical methods, distributions, variables, and spread/variation metrics. Site: https://stato-ontology.org/.
stato.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

obi.label: Ontology for Biomedical Investigations
obi.documentation: OBO Foundry ontology of biological and clinical investigations. Used here for mid-level concepts (e.g., 'independent variable' OBI:0000750) that STATO imports rather than re-defining.
obi.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

schema.label: Schema.org
schema.documentation: General-purpose linked-data vocabulary. CURIE local part is the term name (e.g., 'schema:name' -> 'https://schema.org/name').

allen_ccf_v3.label: Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework v3
allen_ccf_v3.documentation: Identifiers are integer region IDs from the Allen CCF v3 structure graph. No canonical web URI is defined here; consumers should resolve via the Allen SDK or equivalent.

empty.label: Empty Ontology (Experimental Measurements, Purposes, and Treatments)
empty.documentation: Empty Ontology by Waltham Data Science — https://github.com/Waltham-Data-Science/empty-ontology. Term IDs are numeric (e.g., 'EMPTY:0000001'). No PURL is in use yet; the canonical artefact is the GitHub-raw OWL file 'empty-base.owl' on the main branch, and CURIEs expand to a fragment within that file (matching the EMPTY_ prefix used inside the OWL). Consumer tooling (e.g., ndi-ontology-matlab) fetches the full OWL and searches by ID/label rather than dereferencing per-term URIs.
empty.spelling_source: ours: the ontology writes its own ids `EMPTY:0000276` (its IRIs end `EMPTY_`), as OBO ID spaces are written; Jess 2026-10-20

placeholder.label: Placeholder namespace for example and in-progress data
placeholder.documentation: Reserved placeholder for documentation examples and for values that have not yet been mapped to a real ontology. Values are not expected to resolve. Flagged approximate so tooling can warn. Distinct from the 'empty' prefix (registered above), which points at the real Empty Ontology.

time.label: OWL-Time (W3C Time Ontology)
time.documentation: W3C Time Ontology in OWL. Expansion rule: 'time:intervalDuring' -> 'http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalDuring'. Used by relative_time_reference.value.relation for Allen's thirteen interval relations. A W3C Recommendation, so terms are stable and nothing needs minting.

orcid.label: ORCID
orcid.spelling_source: the issuer gives no CURIE (its API returns a `uri` and a bare `path`), so the issuer's name for the id; Q1, Jess

doi.label: Digital Object Identifier
doi.spelling_source: the CURIE form Crossref recommended until 2017 (`doi:10.NNNN/doisuffix`) and the DOI Handbook's presentation form ("doi:10.1006/jmbi.1998.2354"); Q1, Jess

ror.label: Research Organization Registry
ror.spelling_source: the issuer gives no CURIE ("The preferred form of the ROR ID is the full URL"), so the issuer's name for the id; Q1, Jess

pubmed.label: PubMed
pubmed.spelling_source: NCBI's name for the id (PMC FAQ: "The PMID is a unique reference number for PubMed citations"); Q2, Jess

pmc.label: PubMed Central
pmc.spelling_source: NCBI's name for the id (PMC FAQ: "The PMCID is a unique reference number or identifier that is assigned to every article that is accepted into PMC"); Q2, Jess

uo.label: Units of Measurement Ontology

spdx.label: Software Package Data Exchange License
spdx.spelling_source: Bioregistry's preferred prefix (fetched 2026-10-21); SPDX itself writes the bare licence identifier (`CC-BY-4.0`) and has no CURIE form

interlex.label: InterLex
interlex.documentation: Bioregistry prefix `interlex` (InterLex, the SciCrunch lexicon of biomedical terms). Bioregistry's browser URL is https://scicrunch.org/scicrunch/interlex/view/ilx_$1; uri_base is the IRI InterLex itself and openMINDS write (http://uri.interlex.org/base/ilx_0739413). Added for the openMINDS experimentalApproach value set (Jess Haley, 2026-10-21). Bioregistry lists `ILX` as a synonym.
interlex.spelling_source: InterLex's own JSON-LD context (http://uri.interlex.org/base/ilx_0739413.jsonld, 2026-10-21) declares `ILX` -> http://uri.interlex.org/base/ilx_, so `ILX:0739413`

go.label: Gene Ontology
go.documentation: Bioregistry prefix `go`. Biological processes, e.g. GO:0001508 action potential (the variable of a spike train observation).
go.spelling_source: OBO PURL: the ID space as written in uri_base

xco.label: Experimental Condition Ontology
xco.documentation: Bioregistry prefix `xco`. Conditions under which measurements are made, e.g. XCO:0000099 control condition (the `logical` covariate marking a stimulus presentation's controls; Jess Haley, 2026-10-22 [control as covariate], V_eta_stimulus_response_model_plan.md).

sio.label: Semanticscience Integrated Ontology
sio.documentation: Bioregistry prefix `sio`. Registered for SIO:000497 is version of, the node of `alternative_of` (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [vocabulary nodes] K3).

prov.documentation: Bioregistry prefix `prov` (no local-id pattern published there). Registered for prov:wasDerivedFrom, the node of `derived_from` (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [derived from general]).

uri_styles.obo_underscore: Concatenate uri_base with the CURIE local part verbatim; underscore-separated form (e.g., 'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_0002436').
uri_styles.direct: Concatenate uri_base with the CURIE local part verbatim (e.g., 'https://schema.org/name').
uri_styles.local: No URI expansion; the CURIE is the authoritative identifier and the uri_base is empty.

documentation: This file is advisory, not enforced structurally by the meta-schema. It is consumed by tooling that needs to expand CURIEs to URIs, warn on unknown prefixes, or flag approximate namespaces. To add a prefix: add an entry under prefixes with all four metadata keys, bump format_version at least PATCH, and update V_gamma_SPEC.md's 'CURIE Registry' section. Each prefix may carry a `pattern` (a regular expression for the local id, from Bioregistry where it has one) so a CURIE's form can be checked; `entity.global_identifier` uses the same prefixes (V_eta_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 6). Each entry carries `spelling` (the prefix as written in documents; a writer emits it), `spelling_source` and `synonyms`. A reader recognises a prefix by the entry's key, its `spelling` or any of its `synonyms`, ignoring case; no two entries share one. `legacy_rewrite` names an older prefix that splits the identifier differently (`WBStrain:00004246` is read as `WormBase:WBStrain00004246`), and `written_as` names the entry an identifier is cited through (`cellosaurus` and `addgene` are written `RRID:CVCL_...` and `RRID:Addgene_...`). V_eta_prefix_spelling_plan.md.
